body.objective: Characterize Weyl gravity FULLY in the reverse-physics sense: for each layer of the theory, which minimal physical assumptions is the layer EQUIVALENT to, with independence witnesses and an honest ledger. Four layers. (1) THE ACTION is done: REVERSE_PHYSICS_WEYL_ACTION_V1 shows S = alpha int sqrt(-g) C^2 is equivalent to five assumptions rather than implied by six, with the derivative order DERIVED from D - 2k = 0 rather than assumed, and RP-PARITY independent on actions but redundant on field equations. (2) THE FIELD EQUATIONS were recorded as never computed by this stream; that was true of the stream and false of the repository, and the layer is now partly discharged (see current_gate). (3) THE GAUGE STRUCTURE (RP-DIFF, the BRST/BV complex) is UNTOUCHED and is the largest genuine hole: RP-DIFF is what makes 'the space of curvature scalars' the right space at all, so it never appears as a row in any matrix and has no independence witness. (4) THE SPECTRUM is partial: weyl-ghost-forced.md proves the uniqueness theorem and the ghost theorem are the same theorem, both following from D - 2k = 0; the DYNAMICAL consequence of the ghost is not characterized, and GHOST_MODEL_OBSTRUCTION showed the coprime obstruction does not decide it in either direction. Underneath all four sits the GEOMETRY column, which PHYSICS-VS-MATH.md itself calls 'the bulk of the intellectual content', imported and unverified.

body.current_gate: ALL THREE VACUOUS ASSUMPTIONS ARE NOW WITNESSED, AND THE DERIVED DERIVATIVE ORDER REQUIRES ALL THREE (REVERSE_PHYSICS_CARRIER_ENLARGEMENTS_V1, reverse_physics/reports/carrier-enlargements.md). RP-METRIC: admitting a compensator scalar of the conformally coupled weight -(D-2)/4 gives density weight D/2 - n + m - k(D-2)/4; phi is a GL scalar so the diffeomorphism condition is still n = m, and imposing both gives k = 2D/(D-2). So sqrt(-g) phi^4 is local, diffeomorphism-invariant, Weyl-invariant and parity-even at DERIVATIVE ORDER ZERO — a witness. THE EXPONENT IS NOT PUT IN: it falls out of two independent conditions and reproduces the standard conformal scalar potential phi^6, phi^4, phi^3 in D = 3, 4, 6, with integer powers occurring EXACTLY in those dimensions since 2D/(D-2) = 2 + 4/(D-2) is an integer iff (D-2) divides 4. That trio is the classical answer and is the sharpest available check that the bookkeeping is right. It also BREAKS both vacuity findings: F3 (diff and Weyl invariance never simultaneously satisfiable at order zero) and F2 (no weight-zero order-zero density in odd dimension, since D = 3 with phi^6 has one) hold exactly as far as RP-METRIC does. RP-LOCAL: allowing j inverse boxes, box^{-1} carries weight +1 so invariance is k - j = D/2, which has EXACTLY ONE solution at j = 0 and one per j otherwise — locality is what makes the classification UNIQUE, not merely finite. Note the net derivative order 2(k-j) = D is UNCHANGED by finitely many inverse boxes; nonlocality buys a different POLE STRUCTURE, not a different derivative count, and the entire-form-factor mechanism cited for infinite-derivative gravity is outside this computation. JOINT CONSEQUENCE, which is the point of doing all three: section 4.3's derived derivative order requires RP-DIFF, RP-METRIC and RP-LOCAL, each failing differently — drop RP-DIFF and order zero becomes available (F3 no longer binds), drop RP-METRIC and order zero becomes available via phi^{2D/(D-2)}, drop RP-LOCAL and every k >= D/2 becomes available so uniqueness is destroyed. Section 4.3 said the standard motivation uses one more physical input than it needs; that stands, and what is now sayable is WHICH inputs it does need. Recorded as section 4.8. GHOST TABLE ROW FILLED IN, CAREFULLY: weyl-ghost-forced.md had RP-DIFF as "not analysed". It can now be analysed and the statement is narrow — dropping RP-DIFF makes weight-zero densities available at derivative order zero so THE POLE-COUNT ARGUMENT NO LONGER RUNS. That is NOT removing the ghost; a non-covariant theory is not thereby ghost-free. What fails is the DERIVATION, which is exactly the status the RP-LOCAL and RP-METRIC rows already carried, so RP-DIFF joins them rather than outranking them. EVERY ASSUMPTION IN THE WEYL LEDGER NOW HAS AN INDEPENDENCE WITNESS. PRIOR STATE, retained for history: THE ENLARGEMENT MOVE IS NOW A STATED METHOD (REVERSE_PHYSICS_CARRIER_VACUITY_V1, reverse_physics/reports/carrier-vacuity.md), and it bears directly on the stream's oldest open problem. Trichotomy: an assumption is VACUOUS (holds on every element), LIVE (both it and its negation realised) or EMPTY (holds on none) on a carrier, and it CAN BE WITNESSED IFF IT IS NOT VACUOUS — so 'no witness found' and 'no witness can exist here' are different findings and a ledger conflating them reports a property of its own arena as a property of the theory. REVERSE-MATHEMATICS CORRESPONDENCE, which is the point: the carrier IS the base, and an assumption vacuous on the carrier IS an axiom the base already proves. THE OPERATION: a carrier is presented by CONSTRUCTION CONSTRAINTS, an assumption that is also a construction constraint is vacuous, and the enlargement that makes it testable is the removal of that constraint. Section 4.2 (RP-REVERSIBLE, constraint exp(tA)) and section 4.7 (RP-DIFF, constraint indices-contract-into-scalars) are both instances. COMPUTED over 33 graded pieces of the order-zero metric densities in D = 2,3,4, exact rational, two rank rails agreeing, 12 pieces over the basis cap listed rather than silently dropped: F1 the diff-invariant subspace is nonzero exactly when n = m; F2 Weyl invariance needs n - m = D/2, which has no integer solution in ODD dimension so there is no Weyl-invariant order-zero metric density there at all — meeting section 3.9 and section 4.6 odd-dimension results from a third direction; F3 therefore RP-DIFF and RP-WEYL are NEVER SIMULTANEOUSLY SATISFIABLE at derivative order zero in any dimension. F3 is the sharp form of the 4.7 consequence: RP-DIFF is not merely used by the derived-order derivation, it is WHAT MAKES DERIVATIVE ORDER ZERO IMPOSSIBLE, and only then does D - 2k = 0 pin the order at D/2. AUDIT FINDING: THREE ledger assumptions are vacuous on the classification's carrier, not one — RP-LOCAL, RP-METRIC and RP-DIFF — and only RP-DIFF has been enlarged. The ledger recorded RP-LOCAL/RP-METRIC as bounding the coordinate space and RP-DIFF as invisible, i.e. one phenomenon filed as two kinds of caveat. Note the coincidence worth watching: RP-LOCAL and RP-METRIC are exactly the two escapes left open by the ghost no-go, so the only surviving routes out of the ghost run through the two assumptions whose carriers have never been enlarged. SELF-CRITICISM SURFACED BY THE AUDIT: on the order-zero carrier RP-DIFF is EMPTY, not LIVE — by F3 nothing there is diff-invariant. The witness stands (T4 asks only for an element satisfying the others and failing A) but a LIVE carrier is strictly better, and the union with the quadratic curvature scalars is LIVE at 3 of 58; that union is the carrier the ledger should quote. OPERATOR CORRECTION in diff_independence.py: it imposed delta(sqrt(-g) M) = 0 where the correct condition is delta M = 0, since sqrt(-g) is already a scalar density of weight one and its contribution cancels from both sides of delta_alg D = -tr(A) D. Both operators give rank 55 and invariant dimension 0 so the RESULT WAS UNAFFECTED, but the control space had always used the correct condition, so the two spaces were being tested against different operators. Fixed; the witness generator count moved from 7 to 4. DECLARATION BOUNDARY: the VACUOUS/LIVE audit assignments are judgement about which construction constraints define the carrier, recorded so they can be disputed; only the graded computation is mechanical. NEXT: enlarge for RP-LOCAL (admit nonlocal densities) and RP-METRIC (admit a compensator scalar), which are now named as the same shape of task rather than permanent limitations. PRIOR STATE, retained for history: PHASE 3 OPENED AND ITS CENTRAL GAP CLOSED — RP-DIFF HAS AN INDEPENDENCE WITNESS (REVERSE_PHYSICS_DIFF_INDEPENDENCE_V1, reverse_physics/reports/diff-independence.md). The ledger had recorded RP-DIFF as having NO witness at all and called it the largest genuine hole; that was true of the CARRIER, not the assumption, and it is the same shape as RP-REVERSIBLE in section 4.2 — unwitnessable on a carrier where the assumption cannot fail, resolved by moving to one where it can. The classification's carrier is quadratic curvature scalars, diff-invariant BY CONSTRUCTION. Enlarging to local metric densities at derivative order zero (dropping the requirement that indices contract into scalars), the lowest weight-zero degree sqrt(-g) h^ab h^cd is 55-dimensional and entirely Weyl invariant while its diffeomorphism-invariant subspace is EXACTLY ZERO — the kernel of the sixteen GL(4) generators, exact rank over Q by two independent routines that agree, with a CONTROL SPACE (h^ab g_cd) whose known one-dimensional invariant the same machinery finds, so the zero is not a broken computation. Every one of the 55 is a witness; sqrt(-g) (g^00)^2 is the explicit one and is moved by 7 of 16 generators. THE CONSEQUENCE IS THE POINT: the witness sits at DERIVATIVE ORDER ZERO, while section 4.3's derived order says k = D/2 = 2. That derivation runs through G3, the conformal weight of the WEYL TENSOR, which is a curvature scalar and hence already diff-covariant. So THE DERIVED DERIVATIVE ORDER REQUIRES RP-DIFF — the stream's best result was silently using the one assumption the ledger had marked as carrying no weight. Section 4.3 stands; its input is now named. This is recorded as section 4.7, the seventh time the separation changed the answer, and the first where the thing that changed was an assumption believed untestable in principle. CONDITIONAL, STATED NOT HIDDEN: this is independence GIVEN RP-METRIC, because the Stuckelberg escape (promote coordinates to fields and any non-covariant theory covariantises) is BLOCKED by the field content rather than refuted; the ledger row traces to both assumptions. SCOPE: derivative order zero and the LOWEST weight-zero degree (2,0) only; degrees (3,1), (4,2), ... are also weight zero and are not classified. NOT QUANTUM: this repository's quantum chain separately computes that pure-Diff anomaly cohomology vanishes in D = 4 (AFN0_DIFF_MIXED_MINIMAL_BV_H14: pure_Diff even 0 odd 0, mixed_independent 0, with the degree-three symmetric invariant space of the metric structure algebra zero and degrees two and four retained as nonzero controls); that is a DIFFERENT question at a DIFFERENT level, it is NOT used as evidence here and this is not evidence for it. SURVEY FINDING WORTH KEEPING: H04_GAUGE_FIXED_BV_RESULT gives the counterterm slot as even {CT_C2, CT_E4} dim 2, odd {CT_C_DUAL_C} dim 1, with CT_BOX_R exact — which is EXACTLY the reverse-physics action classification, computed by a completely different route (BRST cohomology in a local jet algebra with ghosts, antifields and gauge fixing, versus exact rational linear algebra on a hand-built coordinate space). Neither was set up to check the other. HAZARD: box R appears in three unrelated roles — CT_BOX_R and ANOM_OMEGA_BOX_R are EXACT (trivial in cohomology, removable by a local counterterm, the familiar scheme-dependence of the box-R trace-anomaly term) while N2's box R is a CLASSICAL trace of field equations whose NON-vanishing carries the trace law. Same symbol, three objects. Also BRST ghosts are not the Ostrogradsky ghost. NEXT: the gauge layer's remaining question is whether the enlarged-carrier result extends past the lowest degree, and whether RP-DIFF and RP-METRIC should be merged into a single ledger row given the Stuckelberg entanglement. PRIOR STATE, retained for history: PHASE 1 COMPLETE — THE GEOMETRY COLUMN IS CLOSED, and the field-equation layer is now characterized by VARIATION rather than by definition. N2 is discharged (REVERSE_PHYSICS_WEYL_TRACE_LAW_V1, reverse_physics/reports/weyl-trace-law.md) and is sharper than the ledger stated it: for S = int sqrt(-g)(a Riem^2 + b Ric^2 + c R^2) the trace of the metric variation is g^{mn} E_mn = 2 (a + b + 3c) box R, where a + b + 3c = 0 is EXACTLY the single linear equation the action classification proves cuts out the Weyl-invariant subspace. So the multiple is 2 (nonzero) and the anomaly FACTORISES into the Weyl-invariance functional times box R, making the kernel of the trace map exactly span{C^2, E4} — which is the RP-WEYL <==> RP-TRACELESS equivalence with its reverse direction supplied. NOTE FOR THE LEDGER'S SHAPE: N2 and G5 need the SAME witness (box R != 0), so a ledger that lost G5 would silently lose N2. The variational link delta int sqrt(-g) C^2 = 4 int sqrt(-g) B_mn delta g^mn is NO LONGER CITED: E^{(C^2)}_mn = 4 B_mn is computed here against the repository's own independently calculated Bach tensor on a metric that is neither Einstein nor conformally flat, and the factor 4 is COMPUTED, agreeing with the Nariai value. The two quadratic field-equation tensors remain IMPORTED textbook forms, validated three independent ways (divergence-freedom — which is what FIXES the Riemann coupling sign, with the opposite sign failing as a control; the Bach cross-check; and the trace law holding at metrics of different symmetry). The Lanczos step E^{(Riem^2)} = 4 E^{(Ric^2)} - E^{(R^2)} is CITED (same content as G4/N3) and the trace law is additionally checked on the {Ric^2, R^2} subspace where no Lanczos input is needed. 3 metrics, 19 checks, 4/4 negative controls rejected; Schwarzschild is included precisely because it WITNESSES NOTHING (Ricci-flat and Einstein, so box R = 0 and B = 0 and every check passes vacuously) and carries a witnesses_nothing flag. NEXT: Phase 3, the gauge layer (RP-DIFF), which is the largest genuine hole; either an independence witness or an exact obstruction showing the question is not well posed there. PRIOR STATE, retained for history: GEOMETRY COLUMN NOW CLOSED EXCEPT N2 (REVERSE_PHYSICS_WEYL_DUAL_DISCHARGE_V1, reverse_physics/reports/weyl-dual-discharge.md). The G6/G8 block is lifted. The fix was NOT to repair the epsilon by trial: hodge.py turned out to fix star_square_sign, the eigenvalues and the projectors but NOT the epsilon index placement on a rank-four tensor, which is where the error lived. The working placement is eps_{abcd} = sqrt(|det g|)[abcd] all-lower, (*T)_{abcd} = (1/2) eps_{ab}^{ef} T_{efcd}, all four indices raised before contraction; the previous attempt double-raised two slots. Reproducing star_square_sign is a CHECKED ROW, not an assumption. FINDING: G8 is TWO statements, not one. Euclidean W_pm^2 = (C^2 +- P)/2 with real projectors; Lorentzian W_pm^2 = (C^2 -+ i P)/2 with the complex projectors hodge.py specifies, and the textbook Euclidean form is CHECKED FALSE in Lorentzian signature rather than merely omitted. G6's computable clause (Riem.*Riem = C.*C) is discharged; its spanning clause is a dimension count and is cited. DISCHARGED (REVERSE_PHYSICS_WEYL_GEOMETRY_DISCHARGE_V1, 21 exact checks): G1 (C^2 = Riem^2 - 2Ric^2 + R^2/3), G2 (the conformal law for R), G3 (the Weyl tensor's conformal weight, which the derived derivative order rests on), G5 (the non-degeneracy witness, previously NAMED and not formalised and ranked by the ledger as the sharpest attack on the programme — matter-dominated FRW gives R = 4/(3t^2) and box R = -8/(3t^4)), and N1 (nabla^a B_ab = 0, computed for the actual Bach tensor). A first attempt got the split ALGEBRA exactly right on Lorentzian Taub-NUT — W_+^2 - W_-^2 = P and W_+^2 + W_-^2 = (C^2 + Cdual^2)/2 both hold exactly at an exact algebraic point — but Cdual^2 != -C^2, i.e. the epsilon index placement/normalization is wrong. The fix is to express the dual in local_bv/hodge.py's conventions, NOT to repair the epsilon by trial. UNWIRED: G4 and G7 are global (topological) and unreachable pointwise, but the transgression work already exists and should be cited. NOT STARTED: the gauge layer. COMPARISON LAYOUT ADDED (REVERSE_PHYSICS_WEYL_VS_EINSTEIN_LEDGER_V1, reverse_physics/reports/OPENS-AND-CHALLENGES.md): the three-column ledger states what the theory IS and cannot state what it DOES relative to Einstein gravity, so the layout gains a DIRECTION (OPENS/CHALLENGES/SHARED) and a LEVEL (L0 action through L4 quantum). The level axis is forced by two results this repository already held: Ric = Lambda g implies B_mn = 0 at L2, and REDUCED_FLAT_EINSTEIN_SYMPLECTIC_EMBEDDING_REFUTED at L3, so 'Einstein gravity is contained in Weyl gravity' is true at L2 and false at L3. The organising claim is a single forced assumption swap (RP-2ND-ORDER for RP-WEYL, jointly unsatisfiable in D=4 because D-2k=0 with derivative order 2k), which makes OPENS and CHALLENGES two halves of one trade rather than a pros-and-cons list; the sharpest pair is one theorem read twice, since the equation that DERIVES the derivative order is the equation that FORCES the ghost. 18 rows, 4 of them OPEN, with rails that forbid citing into the MATHEMATICS column, require a counterfactual for every PHYSICS row, and require level flips and trade edges to be mutual. No row is new physics.
body.stop_condition: EITHER every entry of the GEOMETRY column is discharged or explicitly cited to an existing certificate, the field-equation layer is characterized by variation rather than definition, and the gauge layer has at least one independence witness for RP-DIFF — at which point 'fully characterized' is a defensible claim for three of four layers with the fourth ledgered; OR a layer returns an exact obstruction showing the reverse-physics question is not well posed there, which is itself the deliverable and must be recorded with the same rails.
body.forbid: claiming any geometric fact is PROVED when it is DISCHARGED — the discharge verifies exactly at specific metrics, which is strictly stronger than an unverified import and strictly weaker than a theorem for all metrics, and the certificate must keep saying so in those words; asserting G8's W_pm^2 = (C^2 pm P)/2 without its signature qualification, since the Lorentzian Hodge star squares to -1 on two-forms (local_bv/hodge.py records eigenvalues pm i) so W_pm are complex conjugates there and the decomposition as stated is EUCLIDEAN; reinventing any convention this repository already maintains — three attempts in this stream (Riemann tensor, Bach tensor, action variation) each concluded 'we do not have this' about the STREAM while the REPOSITORY had it, and the fourth (the Hodge dual) produced a wrong normalization; promoting a discharge on a Ricci-flat metric to a statement about the R^2 or Ric^2 coefficients, which VANISH there and cannot be seen; using any certificate in this stream as evidence inside the Weyl classical or quantum chains, or vice versa; treating the coprime/ghost toy-model results as statements about Weyl gravity, which they explicitly are not.
